tool.name: get_service_status
tool.description: Get the status of a systemd service including whether it's running, its PID, and when it started.

when_to_use.trigger: User asks if a service is running
User wants to check service health
User asks about a specific daemon status
Troubleshooting why a service isn't working

parameters.param: Name of the systemd service (e.g., 'docker', 'nginx', 'ssh', 'postgresql'). Do not include the .service suffix.

safety_rules.rule: This is a read-only tool - always safe to execute
Only checks status, does not start/stop/restart services

example.input: What's the status of the SSH daemon?
